title: Lumixy - Service Provider Marketplace
description: React Native marketplace app connecting customers with local service providers. Customers browse approved providers by category, providers complete a multi-step onboarding and track approval status, and admins review applications.

title: Lumixy Backend - RESTful API
description: Laravel REST API powering the Lumixy marketplace. Token-based authentication with Sanctum, multi-step provider onboarding, an admin approval workflow, work-gallery uploads, and paginated public endpoints.

title: Technician Hiring Platform (THP)
description: Full-stack web application connecting job owners with skilled technicians. Job owners can post tasks, technicians browse opportunities and submit proposals. Features real-time messaging, notifications, and review system.

title: THP Backend - RESTful API
description: Laravel REST API behind the Technician Hiring Platform, consumed by the Angular frontend. Three-role user system for employers, artisans and admins, two-step OTP login, signed email verification, and job and bidding endpoints.

title: Ali Portfolio Website
description: This portfolio: a responsive single-page site with an animated 3D background, scroll-driven motion, glassmorphism UI and a dark theme. Every section is driven from JSON data, so content stays easy to update.

title: Time4Meds Mobile App Design
description: Designed comprehensive mobile app enabling patients to manage medications, access health content, and communicate with doctors. Focus on intuitive UI/UX with wireframing and prototyping.

title: Hotels and Flights Booking System
description: Full-stack travel agency booking application. Developed secure user authentication module with registration and password reset features using Java, JavaFX for frontend, and MySQL database.

title: Social Media Platform (Web 1 Project)
description: Basic responsive website built as part of the Web 1 course. Collaborated in a 3-member team to build two core pages of a social media platform with modern UI design.

title: Quality Assurance Toolkit
description: JUnit 5 test suite built for the Software Quality Assurance course, exercising unit-testing techniques against calculator, product, recipe-book, and user-service classes with parameterised and lifecycle-based tests.

title: Data Structures Practice
description: Self-contained C++ programs covering core data structures and algorithms - stacks, queues, linked lists and trees - each with its own operations and complexity notes.

title: Udacity Projects Collection
description: Four projects completed across Udacity courses: a multi-page HTML and CSS site, a SCSS and BEM portfolio build, a Python resume-analysis tool, and a JavaScript card game covered by automated tests.
